تنتهجن (form VII)
# تَنْتَهِجْنَ (tantahijna) /tan.ta.hid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# تُنْتَهَجْنَ (tuntahajna) /tun.ta.had͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
